source: UCI AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance Dataset generator documentation

TWF.interpretation: Tool-wear exposure interval; the generator injects failures stochastically inside the interval.

HDF.rule: Process temperature - Air temperature < 8.6 AND Rotational speed < 1380

PWF.rule: mechanical power < 3500 W OR mechanical power > 9000 W

RNF.interpretation: Random failure with no feature-based deterministic rule.
